item.title: Tuesday 4 PM Update, Nov 10
item.description:
The Tuesday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 10, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Jim Jordan beats Steve Scalise to lead House Republicans and John Thune keeps the Senate GOP top job after a failed delay push, as the Hegseth impeachment vote nears; the House Oversight Committee's Epstein report and the Democratic pushback; the Justice Department charges three Iranian-backed operatives in nearly 20 attacks and the foiled RAF Fairford plot, while Rubio tells the G7 economic pressure on Iran is working and the Abu Dhabi talks wrap day one; stocks close lower on rate-hike bets as Nvidia slides again and a House chairman threatens Jensen Huang with a subpoena; SpaceX's Starlink Mini 2 with a swappable battery; Anthropic sets its IPO price range; Microsoft's November Patch Tuesday and an Outlook flaw under attack; your X feed; a New Hampshire admiral home for Veterans Day; and an orphaned baby walrus who found a new herd. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday 1 PM Update, Nov 10
item.description:
The Tuesday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 10, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Speaker Johnson says Republicans have the votes to sideline the Hegseth impeachment as Don Bacon comes out against it and Massie plans article-by-article votes; Senate Republicans air grievances and weigh a delay while House Republicans vote this afternoon; Russia pounds Ukraine's power grid during the Abu Dhabi talks, the U.S. moves tankers out of a British base over a reported Iran threat, Qatar sees progress with Tehran, and a deadly fog pileup in Bulgaria; midday markets slide on rate-hike bets, with the biggest jump in the two-year yield in more than a year and a new report on Nvidia's China chip sales; Ring's flying home security drone; Google's Gemini 4 Carbon goes public; Barracuda flaws now under attack and a Paint fix that Windows Update won't deliver; your X feed; Veterans Day across southern New Hampshire, a new veterans plate and a Lancers playoff rematch and a Doberman who sensed her baby's heart was racing. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
